sourceSentences: [0] So, I walked over here, went for the E start and E with approach velocity allows me to get a nice Q. And if I aim my Q a little bit better, I would have got the knockup as well.

[0] The general rule, of course, if you get the knockup, you want to get it, but it’s always better to be safe than sorry. It’s better to guarantee that it hits than be greedy and they step out of it.

[0] So, this is where if you hit the E, you you pop your W because you want to have your W come up cuz me hitting that E makes me know I’m going to hit a Q onto him here because he’s slowed from the EM
[0] But see the mindset if I miss my E, I won’t use my W. Too much mana to be wasting like that.

[0] So you can see I just queued back in the bush, chill because you don’t have second wind. You don’t have second wind, so you do lose a lot of sustain. So you mainly want to be playing around your spell.

[1] Ryze isn’t played too often, however if you have to play vs him it won’t be easy. Only trade with him, once his W (his prison) is down. You can try to all in with E and R to burn his flash. Push waves and roam.
[1] Will wave clear very fast, and in late game he will deal a lot of damage, but except his passive his mobility is quite low try to punish him later, when phase rush and his passive are down.
